title: Telemetry: Add project age
body:
Closes N/A

## What I did

Collect the project age so we can understand whether Storybook is being installed into new projects

comments.body:
The `projectSince` value should be a number, not a string. Since the code uses `getProjectSince()?.getTime()` which returns a number (or undefined), and this is serialized with `JSON.stringify`, the value will appear as a number in the JSON output. The documentation should show it as `"projectSince": 1717334400000` instead of `"projectSince": "1717334400000"`.
```suggestion
    "projectSince": 1717334400000
```

comments.body: The `getProjectSince` function runs a git command every time it's called, which could be inefficient if telemetry is sent multiple times during a session. Consider caching the result similar to how `getAnonymousProjectId` caches its result in the `anonymousProjectId` variable. This would improve performance by avoiding repeated git executions for the same information.
